mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 1.0%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When both GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) are rising above their 12-month moving averages, it indicates strong economic demand that supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both rise above their 12-month moving averages
failure_condition: The interaction signal (both above 12mo MA) fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.0%, it indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days because high unemployment indicates weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high-UNRATE periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 signals robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO rises above 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.5% and the unemployment rate falls below 5.0%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market, which supports economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5% AND UNRATE falls below 5.0%
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS>0.5% and UNRATE<5.0%) fails to produce positive 60d returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200.0 signals strong demand for housing, which indicates a robust economy and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST rises above 1200.0.
